marta: Starting pre-deploy for runtime v3.5 — slot 22:00 UTC tonight. Plan: 5% canary -> 25% -> 100%. Asking for quick ack from smoke owners and rollback owner. Checklist below, pls ack when ready.

marta: Checklist (quick):
- [ ] Owners assigned (smoke/rollback)
- [ ] DB migrations: none
- [ ] Feature flag ready: runtime_v35 toggle
- [ ] Canary health probe configured (10s interval)
- [ ] Autoscaling paused for immediate ramp window
- [ ] Rollback playbook staged

raj: I'm smoke owner. I'll run smoke-runner and watch p95 latency, error-rate, and traces. I can be on call for the 22:00 slot.

alex: I'll be rollback owner. Rollback patch is prepped at branch `hotfix/rollback-runtime-3.5` and a short command: `./deploy rollback --to=runtime-3.4 --slot=22` documented in the runbook. I ack.

devops: Quick configs I pushed:
- Feature flag `runtime_v35` created in flags service (stage + prod).
- Canary routing rule id: rt-canary-1758 set to 5%.
- Autoscaler pause window set: 22:00-22:10 UTC.
No DB migrations.

marta: Awesome, marking owners: smoke=@raj, rollback=@alex. devops — can you attach the smoke script and healthcheck endpoints here?

devops: Smoke script: `scripts/smoke/runtime_smoke.sh` (uses /internal/health and /v1/complete). Health check curl: `curl -sS -f https://api.redwood.test/internal/health` returns JSON.

raj: Plan for checks:
1) run smoke script against canary endpoints
2) confirm p95 < 450ms, error-rate < 0.5% for 5m window
3) verify KV cache hit-rate > baseline
If any violation -> pause rollout and call rollback owner. I'll post results as thread messages.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved for 2025-11-10 22:00 UTC. CI: all green. Canary config validated.

marta: Small rollback drill: alex, will you rehearse the rollback command in staging at 21:00 UTC? Just a dry-run.

alex: Yep, will do the dry-run at 21:00 and report here.

raj: :thumbsup: I'll be standing by. If I see >0.5% 5m errors I'll trigger pause.

marta: Thanks all — marking checklist as: Owners assigned ✅, DB migrations ✅ (none), flag created ✅, canary rule ✅, autoscaler pause ✅, rollback prepped ✅. Final ack?

alex: Ack from me.

raj: Ack. Posting smoke job results after dry-run.

devops: Noted. I'll keep an eye on canary routing and unpause autoscaling after 22:12 if all clear.

marta: Great — will do the formal go/no-go ping at T-30m (21:30 UTC).
